title: 2008 AMC 12B Problem 10
statement: Bricklayer Brenda would take \(9\) hours to build a chimney alone, and bricklayer Brandon would take \(10\) hours to build it alone. When they work together, they talk a lot, and their combined output is decreased by \(10\) bricks per hour. Working together, they build the chimney in \(5\) hours. How many bricks are in the chimney?

solutions.text:
Let \(n\) be the number of bricks. Alone, Brenda lays \(\tfrac{n}{9}\) bricks per hour and Brandon lays \(\tfrac{n}{10}.\) Together, their rate is \(\tfrac{n}{9} + \tfrac{n}{10} - 10.\)

Working for \(5\) hours completes the chimney: \[ 5\left(\tfrac{n}{9} + \tfrac{n}{10} - 10\right) = n. \] Expanding, \(\tfrac{5n}{9} + \tfrac{5n}{10} - 50 = n,\) so \(\tfrac{95n}{90} - n = 50,\) giving \(\tfrac{5n}{90} = 50.\)

Hence \(n = 900.\)

Thus, the correct answer is B.
hints: If the chimney has \(n\) bricks, Brenda lays \(\tfrac{n}{9}\) per hour and Brandon lays \(\tfrac{n}{10}\) per hour
Together they lay \(\tfrac{n}{9} + \tfrac{n}{10} - 10\) bricks per hour, and \(5\) hours of this equals \(n\)
